prompt_text: All in one fundraising and CRM solution
response_text:
### Top All-in-One Fundraising and CRM Solutions for Nonprofits

Based on the latest 2026 reviews and platform details, here are the strongest all-in-one options that combine CRM (donor management, tracking, reporting) with native fundraising tools (donations, events, campaigns, payments) in a single unified platform. These eliminate the need for multiple tools, providing a 360-degree view of donors, volunteers, and revenue streams. I've prioritized those repeatedly ranked highest for ease of use, features, and value across small to mid-sized nonprofits.

#### Quick Comparison Table
| Platform | Key Strengths | Best For | Pricing Starting Point (2026 Est.) | Standout Features |
|----------|---------------|----------|------------------------------------|-------------------|
| **Mightycause** | Full CRM built into fundraising; auto-creates donor profiles from gifts | Small/mid-sized orgs wanting simplicity | Free (included with fundraising) | Peer-to-peer, events, CRM auto-sync; no setup consultants needed |
| **Bloomerang (w/ Kindful)** | Donor retention analytics, interactive dashboards | Retention-focused fundraisers | ~$125/mo | Wealth screening, peer-to-peer, volunteer tools, personalized emails |
| **CharityEngine** | Largest built-in fundraising suite; no integrations needed | Comprehensive donor journeys | Not specified (contact for demo) | Advocacy, auctions, payments, marketing automation, text-to-give |
| **ClearView CRM** | Mobile-first for field staff; pledge drives & events | Hospitals/churches with engagement focus | Not specified | 360° constituent views, sales tracking, unified database |
| **Giveffect** | 10-in-1 automation (CRM + volunteers + events) | Growth-oriented teams reducing busywork | Not specified | AI-driven data entry, crowdfunding, auctions, full relationship history |
| **Sumac CRM** | Most functionality (case mgmt, grants, prospects) | Orgs needing extensions like memberships/volunteers | Affordable (not specified) | Donations, case management, custom add-ons; easy to use |
| **Neon CRM** | Central hub for revenue streams + engagement | Growing orgs outgrowing spreadsheets | ~$99/mo | Events, memberships, peer-to-peer, volunteer mgmt |
| **Funraise** | Intuitive UI with pop-up forms & websites | Modern, flexible fundraising | Not specified | Donor CRM, integrations (e.g., matching gifts), engagement tracking |
| **DonorPerfect** | Cloud-based donor profiles + events | Small/medium nonprofits | Not specified | Monthly giving, ticketing, annual appeals, strong support |
| **Givebutter** | Donor mgmt + full fundraising suite | All sizes; matching gift automation | Not specified | Engagement tracking, direct Double the Donation integration |

#### Why These Stand Out
- **Unified Data**: All provide one database/login for donors, linking gifts, events, volunteers, and interactions (e.g., Bloomerang's dashboards, CharityEngine's hub).
- **Fundraising Power**: Native tools for online/recurring donations, peer-to-peer, events/auctions, payments (e.g., Mightycause auto-CRM from donations; Giveffect's all-campaign support).
- **2026 Trends**: Emphasis on AI automation (Giveffect), mobile access (ClearView), and retention analytics (Bloomerang). Free/open-source like CiviCRM works for tech-savvy teams but requires dev skills.
- **Top Picks by Need**:
  - **Budget-Friendly Starter**: Mightycause (free CRM with fundraising).
  - **Feature-Rich**: Sumac or CharityEngine (most modules).
  - **Retention/Engagement**: Bloomerang.
  - **Events/Volunteers**: Giveffect or Neon CRM.

Most offer demos/trials. Evaluate based on your org size, tech comfort, and must-haves (e.g., grants via Sumac, matching gifts via Givebutter/Funraise). For enterprise, consider Salesforce NPSP (free core but needs apps). Sources: LiveImpact, GoodUnited, Societ, Mightycause, Double the Donation (2026 updates).
